corpus.definition: audit slice of the 241 registered Exp-8 runs (210 RNADesign-210 tasks + 31 PA sessions; PA_028 = exp8_r2_pa028)

representative.rule: multi-turn PA sessions; most distinct attributed gate verdicts; ties -> median attributed event count among tied; residual ties -> lowest PA number (registered with the corpus confirmation 2026-08-27)
representative.correction_disclosure: The corpus-confirmation message claimed the rule uniquely selects PA_024; that pre-check compared only the four largest PA sessions. The full candidate set has three sessions with all three verdict types (exp8_pa019 / exp8_pa024 / exp8_pa036); the registered median tie-break selects exp8_pa036. Rule applied as registered.
